Convert stream grid to vector stream

grid2stream.Rd

Converts a raster stream grid to a vector line layer using whitebox::wbt_raster_streams_to_vector().

Usage

grid2stream(f_dir, str_grid, output = NULL, set_crs = TRUE)

Arguments

f_dir

Flow direction raster of class SpatRaster.

str_grid

Stream grid raster of class SpatRaster. Required if snap = TRUE.

output

Character. Optional file path to save the output stream vector. If NULL (default), the result is returned in memory only.

set_crs

Logical. Whether the output should inherit the CRS from f_dir. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

A vector line layer of class sf.
